notes.title: Mirrored Patch 1.01 Live
notes.content:
Mirrored patch 1.01 is now live! Thankyou all for playing Mirrored, especially those who took time to feedback and write reviews. It really helps us a ton and is greatly appreciated. This patch should address all major issues reported, so without further ado; the fixes:

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixes to various stability, gameplay and UI issues
[*]Fixed build config on GL platforms (missing executable problem)
[*]Fixed issue with a broken item combination
[*]Added a launcher
[*]Added mouse sensitivity and inversion control and UI
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]

Users on GL platforms (Mac and Linux) may expereince issues switching resolutions in game. Icons may disappear or corrupt. Restarting the game will resolve this issue.

Happy puzzling!
